name: Kadenokouji Shizuri
source: [url=/c151228]Wakana[/url]'s former editor from the company "Kaihyou Publishing." She had hoped to collaborate with Wakana in creating more works together but ended in failure due to excessive interference from her seniors. She feels responsible for breaking Wakana's spirit, and even though they no longer work together, she still drops by Wakana's workplace to check on her, but does not have the courage to talk to her.
